description:
Converts a Gregorian date to the Chinese lunisolar calendar or back: lunar year, month, day, whether the month is a leap month, when it began, and the solar term in effect. Takes "date" or "lunar", one of the two.

A month starts on the day, at Beijing time, of its new moon, so tables built in another zone can put months a day off. Placement follows GB/T 33661-2017. Leap months, 2033-2035 and pre-1929 dates come back unverified, with no date.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

date.description: Gregorian date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1929-3025. Example: "2024-02-10". Neither: today (UTC).

leap.description: "yes" if the lunar date is in a leap month; only with lunar. Example: "yes".

lunar.description: Lunar year-month-day, YYYY-MM-DD, year = Gregorian year of its month 1. Example: "2024-01-01".

name: convert_chinese_lunar_date
title: Chinese lunar date converter
